context_for_next_testing_agent: Bitcoin tax payment feature fully tested and working. The CryptoPaymentSection component appears after a withdrawal is created (when showTaxPayment=true). Backend endpoints: GET /api/crypto-wallets returns wallet addresses, POST /api/transactions/{id}/pay-tax-crypto submits payment with btc_address field and returns Spanish success message, GET /api/transactions/{id}/crypto-payment returns array of payments. BTC address validation uses regex for Legacy (1...), SegWit (3...), and Bech32 (bc1...) formats. Email notifications are sent via Resend (non-blocking background tasks).
